note: Chapter 00 owns no fact namespace: every AWS fact it needs is an exam-* fact owned by chapter 01 (book.fact_namespaces). For an item still uncovered, the miner files one request with: python3 aws-saa-book/tools/saa.py facts request --chapter 00 --service exam --question TEXT --where calendar.md#<section id>. Items with status no-fact need no fact and no request; they are listed so the writer knows which numbers end with the no-fact: plan marker.
